cards.mood: The piece opens with a somber, intimate atmosphere that gradually accumulates tension through the verses.
cards.palette: A clean electric guitar with a chorus effect establishes the harmonic foundation in the intro and verses, switching to a heavily distorted, palm-muted rhythm guitar that drives the choruses and breakdown.

[Intro]
[Verse]
Shadows stretch across the hollow floor
Tracing paths where the echoes roar
